pull.title: Test: Cover malformed and truncated tx encodings
pull.body:
Check that every strict prefix of a witness transaction fails to deserialize, and that a witness flag of 0x02, which skips the witness section, is rejected as unknown optional data. Also check that CompactSize prefixes missing some of the bytes they announce fail to read.

These were discovered by finding gaps in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s)
